# Source license and update terms — draft

Status: DRAFT, not approved for accepting public source orders.

A source purchase delivers the acquired release through a per-customer clean
repository and a matching checksum ZIP after a paid source order is verified.
The purchase includes twelve months of updates and basic technical support.
Acquired source files remain accessible and usable after that period expires.
No vendor license server disables an acquired runtime.

After expiry, delivery of later releases stops. Renewal enables subsequent
release access without changing acquired version ownership. Each delivery is
recorded by version and artifact checksum; a shared repository must not expose
future releases to expired buyers or disclose another buyer's records.

Unresolved before public sale: legal seller/buyer terms, project and seat limits,
client-use and redistribution rules, transfer rights, source and renewal price,
currency/tax presentation, approved renewal arithmetic, and refund/cancellation
policy. Applicable mandatory rights and merchant terms require review; this
draft does not invent a refund deadline or waive statutory rights.

Source orders do not buy video credits, create a SaaS workspace, or enter the
buyer's Stripe/FirstPromoter program. Source-affiliate eligibility, attribution,
commission, reversal and payout terms belong to the merchant's separately
approved Lemon Squeezy program and remain unresolved here.
